resolution.note: two sessions of one task get the same edit-standards holdout arm; test fails on origin/main source (exit 1), passes with fix

title: Edit-standards holdout arm is keyed by task, not session id
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-rerun-report.md (GPT-6.2 Astra rerun on 075e12b), verified by a read-only reader 2026-11-17.
Evidence: src/hook/edit-standards.ts:125,128 key the holdout by session id, so a retried session can land in the other arm.
Outcome: a test with two session ids for the same task exits 0 and asserts both get the same arm.
Proof: the test fails before the fix and passes after.
